description: CRYPTO_SPEC §9.1: lease wrap for workload leases (HPKE Base mode single-shot Seal, same primitive as §5). Binding claims_digest into info makes reuse of a lease response in a different workload context fail decryption. Seal is pinned via hpke-js ekm derandomize (the panva implementation is verified on the Open direction + round-trip)
persistence_note: Lease wraps are not persisted (they do not enter dek_wraps — §9.1). Because they exist only within the response scope, no §5.1 registration signature accompanies them (signers are members on the chain; an attribution signature cannot exist for a server-generated wrap)
provenance_note: The coordinates (project / environment / epoch) and the basic DEK are identical to server-basic in dek-wrap.json. This represents, with real data, the shape where the server opens its own wrap and re-wraps the same DEK to the workload ephemeral key (§9.1 — the server does not decrypt values)

workload_keypair.note: The workload's ephemeral X25519 key. Pinned via DeriveKeyPair(ikmW) for vector determinism, but in real operation it is generated randomly each time and discarded when the job ends (§9.1)

claims.subject: repo:maruhi-example/demo:ref:refs/heads/main
claims.note: claims_digest_hex = lower_hex(SHA-256(LP(domain, issuer_url, subject, audience))). The server and the workload independently compute the same value from the issuer / sub / aud of a verified OIDC token. other_* is the context of same issuer / audience with a different subject (a different branch); material for info-claims-digest-mismatch

vectors.name: basic
vectors.note: Lease wrap for the current epoch. The DEK is identical to server-basic in dek-wrap.json (the DEK the server opened and re-wrapped)

vectors.name: prior-epoch
vectors.note: The past-epoch share included in the same lease response (§14-2: every epoch used by the latest values + the current epoch). Pins that both the DEK and info are independent per epoch

negative.name: info-project-mismatch
negative.note: Transplanting to a different project fails Open

negative.name: info-environment-mismatch
negative.note: Transplanting to a different environment fails Open (blocks reuse across disclosure scopes)

negative.name: info-epoch-mismatch
negative.note: Transplanting to a different epoch fails Open

negative.name: info-claims-digest-mismatch
negative.note: A claims_digest from a different workload context (same issuer / audience, different subject) fails Open. The core of lease responses being non-transferable to another job (§9.1)

negative.name: info-dek-wrap-domain
negative.note: info with the domain string swapped to §5's dek-wrap fails Open (domain separation between persistent wraps and lease wraps)
